The Fire's punishment is told only by its verses, as text: the picture stays dark stone. src/lib/abodes.test.js checks these rules.
title: The two abodes
sub: What the Quran says about Paradise and the Fire, and what leads there.
orderNote: The names are from the Quran. Their order as levels comes from later scholars: only al-Firdaus as the highest is from a sahih hadith.
closing: Only God knows where anyone will be. This page shows what the verses say. It is not a judgment on anyone.

throne.title: The Throne
throne.label: The Throne, which God created
throne.line: Above the highest garden is the Throne, which God created. Angels surround it, praising their Lord.

note.line: God is not shown here and cannot be pictured: there is nothing like Him.

mercy.line: Deeds are the way, but it is God's mercy that admits anyone.

leads.line: Humble in prayer, turning from idle talk, paying zakah, chaste, true to trusts and promises, guarding the prayers.

says.line: They inherit it and stay for ever, never wishing to move.

leads.line: Keeping God's covenant, joining what He ordered joined, patience for His sake, prayer, giving in secret and in public, and answering evil with good.

says.line: They enter with the righteous of their families, and angels come in from every gate with peace.

leads.line: Faith and righteous deeds, and being foremost in doing good.

says.line: Rivers flow beneath them. Their call there is God's praise, and their greeting is peace.

leads.line: Fearing the standing before one's Lord, and holding the soul back from its desires.

says.line: A place of welcome, given for what they used to do.

leads.line: Doing good. God Himself invites to it, and gives the good-doers the best, and more.

says.line: It is with their Lord, and He is their protecting friend.

leads.line: Reciting God's Book, praying, and giving in secret and in public. Even some who wronged themselves enter, by His bounty.

says.line: No sorrow, no fatigue and no weariness there. Its people say: praise be to God.

leads.line: It is promised to the righteous, those mindful of God.

says.line: Whatever they wish is theirs, for ever: a promise worth asking God for.

items.title: The bridge
items.line: A bridge is laid across the Fire, and all come to it.

items.title: The wall with a door
items.line: A wall with a door: mercy on its inner side, punishment on the outer.

items.title: The heights
items.line: A partition between the two, with heights where some wait, longing for the Garden.

wayBack.line: Do not despair of God's mercy: He forgives all sins for whoever turns back, believes and does good.

leads.line: Being too proud to worship God, though He promises to answer whoever calls on Him.

says.line: It has seven gates, each with its own share.

leads.line: Turning away from the truth, then gathering wealth and hoarding it.

says.line: A flame that strips away the skin.

leads.line: Scorning and mocking people, and counting wealth as if it would make one live for ever.

says.line: God's fire, kept burning, rising over the hearts, closed over them in long columns.

leads.line: Unjustly eating the property of orphans. Refusing to listen, or to think.

says.line: There they admit their sin, and are kept far away.

leads.line: Asked what brought them there, they answer: we did not pray, we did not feed the poor, we joined in vain talk, and we denied the Day.

says.line: It spares nothing and leaves nothing. Nineteen angels are over it.

leads.line: Transgressing, and preferring the life of this world.

says.line: Its welcome is scalding water, and the burning of Hellfire.

leads.line: Scales light with good. The Quran names the hypocrites in the lowest depths of the Fire.

says.line: An abyss, and a fire burning intensely hot.

wayBack.line: Except those who repent, put things right, hold fast to God and are sincere: they will be with the believers.
